Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was riding in the front passenger seat when our vehicle was struck from behind while stopped at a traffic light in
Pasadena, Texas. The impact was sharp and pushed my head back and then forward, and I felt an immediate
stiffness in my neck that grew worse over the next hour. I was taken to be checked, where I was told I had a neck
strain. Looking back, I have gone over what happened many times, and I have remembered a few small things more
clearly since the day it happened, such as the other car's position and how long we sat before the impact, but the
core of my account has not changed. The driver of my vehicle is the person named on the policy, and she was fully
stopped and braking was not possible in time. I am still experiencing soreness and have been following the treatment
plan I was given.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
